other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leakage during Feature Engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes aggregations (e.g., group medians and means) and imputation statistics on the entire training dataset before performing cross-validation splitting. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, leading to overly optimistic cross-validation evaluation scores.

summary: The solution is generally well-structured, employing proper cross-validation, strong domain-specific feature engineering, and a robust optimized rank ensemble. However, it computes imputation medians and groupby aggregations on the entire training set prior to K-fold splitting, introducing validation leakage that could make the local cross-validation scores overly optimistic.
